The Chandigarh Tricity — Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula — has a growing need for porta cabins across its IT parks, industrial phases, and active construction corridors. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and despatches them to Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula in 3 to 5 days. We do not run a local Chandigarh branch — every cabin is built at our factory and delivered direct to your site, which keeps quality consistent and pricing transparent. For a porta cabin in Chandigarh, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a quote.

Why SAMAN for Porta Cabins in the Chandigarh Tricity

Most porta cabin results a Chandigarh buyer finds online are IndiaMART and TradeIndia listing pages — marketplace aggregations that mix dozens of suppliers and reveal nothing about frame grade, panel specification, or who actually builds the cabin.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. We are honest about one thing upfront: we do not have a Chandigarh factory or showroom. Your cabin is built at our Greater Noida unit and delivered to your Tricity site. That is the model that lets us guarantee:

  • A consistent, factory-controlled build — not a workshop-improvised one
  • The same IS 2062 Grade A frame and certified quality on every order
  • A transparent price with no local-reseller markup added on top

Our porta cabin manufacturing follows one factory standard on every order, whatever the Tricity destination. We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications, along with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer’s cost.

Chandigarh Tricity’s Zones and Porta Cabin Demand

The Tricity spreads porta cabin demand across three administrations and several distinct industrial and construction zones:

Chandigarh Industrial Area, Phase 1 & 2 (PIN 160002): The city’s core industrial belt. Light engineering, printing, and service-industry units here use security cabins at plot entries and small portable offices. Single-room and double-room formats dominate.

Mohali Industrial Area / IT City (SAS Nagar, PIN 160055): Mohali is the Tricity’s growth engine — IT parks, pharmaceutical units (in the nearby Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh belt), and large commercial real-estate projects. IT campus construction and pharma plant expansion create demand for multi-room contractor offices and on-site management cabins.

Panchkula Industrial Area, Phase 1 & 2 (PIN 134113): Engineering, food processing, and packaging units. Security posts at factory gates and portable stores are the common requirement. Panchkula’s HSIIDC zones also see periodic greenfield construction needing site offices.

Mohali Aerocity and New Sectors: Large residential and commercial development in Mohali’s new sectors (Aerocity, Sector 66–90) generates demand for portable sales offices at project launches and site-management cabins throughout construction.

Zirakpur–Panchkula–Kalka Corridor: Rapid mixed-use development along this corridor, plus NH-7 and NH-5 infrastructure work, requires portable project offices at construction sites — a recurring order type for a manufacturer with a direct despatch route from Greater Noida.

SAMAN despatches from Greater Noida via NH-44. Chandigarh is roughly 260 km on a direct flatbed run — one of our shortest North-region delivery routes, reaching the Tricity in 3–5 days. The same dispatch yard serves our Delhi NCR porta cabin hub.

Porta Cabin Specifications

The Tricity’s climate runs from hot summers (40°C+ in May–June) to cold winters with near-freezing nights, plus a monsoon season from July to September. Our cabins are specified to handle this full range.

  • Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded joints, zinc-phosphate primed, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.
  • Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard — their insulation helps in both the hot summer and the cold Tricity winter. Cement-board panels available for longer-duration outdoor industrial installations.
  • Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling for thermal comfort across both temperature extremes. Optional turbo ventilators for summer airflow.
  • Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.
  • Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows. Fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.
  • Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room modular block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula

Porta cabins from SAMAN serve a wide range of uses across the Tricity:

  • IT park and campus construction offices: Contractor and PMC offices at Mohali IT City and commercial campus projects throughout the construction phase.
  • Industrial security cabins: Guard rooms at factory gate entries in Chandigarh Phase 1 & 2, Panchkula Industrial Area, and Mohali’s industrial plots.
  • Real-estate sales offices: Portable cabin sales offices at residential project launches in Mohali’s new sectors and the Zirakpur corridor.
  • Labour accommodation: Worker colony blocks at large construction projects in Mohali Aerocity and Panchkula expansion zones.
  • Government and PWD site offices: Project offices for infrastructure works on NH-7, NH-5, and Tricity road-widening projects.
  • Temporary stores: Lockable portable material and equipment stores at project yards across the Tricity.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built to your specification:

  • Custom room dimensions and multi-room modular layouts
  • Colour choice from standard RAL palette
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point) for summer use
  • Insulation upgrade options for winter comfort in working offices
  • Turbo ventilators for summer airflow
  • Internal false ceiling
  • Internal partition walls
  • Extra door or window units
  • Plumbing provision for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where structural load calculations allow

Share your Tricity site location, required size, and use case. We confirm specifications and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Chandigarh

The price of a porta cabin in Chandigarh, Mohali, or Panchkula depends on:

  1. Size: 8×10 ft single-room at the entry level; 10×40 ft four-room block at the upper end.
  2. Panel type: PUF sandwich panel (standard, good insulation for Tricity winters) vs cement-board.
  3. Fit-out level: Structural shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC provision, insulation upgrade).
  4. Climate additions: AC provision for summer, insulation upgrade for winter — both worth factoring in for year-round office use.
  5. Quantity: Orders for 5 or more units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

Because we sell factory-direct with no local-reseller markup, the landed cost of a porta cabin in the Chandigarh Tricity stays competitive even after delivery. Once we confirm your size, panel, and fit-out, the quoted figure is firm, with no hidden add-ons after the order. For an accurate price, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in the Tricity

We despatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via NH-44 on flatbed trucks. At roughly 260 km, Chandigarh is one of our shortest North-region routes. Standard transit: 3–5 days. Have a level base ready before the truck arrives — a pre-cast RCC plinth, a concrete pad, or firm compacted ground suits most single-room and multi-room units, and lets the crew set the cabin the same day.

On delivery, the cabin is placed on your pre-cast RCC plinth. Anchor bolts are secured, panels confirmed, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready to use within hours of arrival. A multi-room block takes about one day on site.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard to Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula. Multiple cabins in one truck — confirm consolidated rate at order stage.

We deliver across North India from the same Greater Noida factory. If you are comparing nearby routes, see our porta cabin in Jaipur and porta cabin delivery in Lucknow pages. We do not have a Tricity showroom or warehouse — every cabin is manufactured to order at Greater Noida and delivered factory-direct to your Chandigarh, Mohali, or Panchkula site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Chandigarh

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Mohali and Panchkula as well as Chandigarh?

Yes. We deliver across the entire Tricity — Chandigarh, Mohali (SAS Nagar), and Panchkula — and to the Zirakpur and Kharar corridors. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard across the Tricity.

Does a porta cabin need permission for a temporary site in Chandigarh?

Porta cabins are temporary structures and most project sites use them without a permanent building permit. However, the Chandigarh Administration, GMADA (for Mohali), and the relevant Panchkula authority each have their own rules for temporary structures on certain land types. Verify with your local approving authority. We provide cabin dimensions and load data if needed for any site-approval paperwork.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Chandigarh?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and any climate additions (AC for summer, insulation upgrade for winter). Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built around your specific site and requirement. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

How does a SAMAN porta cabin handle the Tricity’s hot summers and cold winters?

The 50 mm PUF sandwich panels provide insulation that helps in both extremes. For peak summer (May–June, 40°C+), we recommend an AC provision and turbo ventilator. For the cold Tricity winter, an internal false ceiling and an insulation upgrade keep a working office comfortable. These are specified at the factory before despatch.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a government or PWD project in the Tricity?

Yes. We supply to government contractors and PWD project managers. Our NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005) are available for vendor documentation, along with ISO certificates, GST registration, PAN, and company incorporation documents. Contact us with your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

Get a Porta Cabin Quote in the Chandigarh Tricity

For a porta cabin in Chandigarh, Mohali, or Panchkula delivered to your site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. Send an enquiry using the form below and we will respond with full specifications, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation for your requirement.
